"One stale_stops start row, one R6" then happens zero times or many times by the half-second tick. --fast hides it: 4 s quotes against a 3 s threshold is the opposite order.

After a BUY the book does not know, the last row stays that BUY: every later round starts on the same mismatch with no E1 and no more buys for the rest of the 200 rounds.
